## Summary

Sajid Afridi (online handle: mrww305) is a Pakistani technology executive and engineer.
He bridges advanced algorithmic development (Computer Vision, NLP, Generative AI, AI
Agents) with zero-trust security paradigms and enterprise-grade MLOps practices. His
dual expertise spans Physical AI (SCADA, IoT, Edge Computing, Anti-Drone Systems) and
Digital AI (LLMs, RAG, Federated Learning). He advises government institutions (NITB
Pakistan) and academia (UMT, City School) on AI and digital transformation.
